items.text: Hello Squires! We're landing a huge game update packed with new features that will completely change your experience with The Plucky Squire!

This update introduces two new game modes—Challenge Mode and Iron Squire Mode—along with new enemies, enemy variants, and minigame updates. So if you’ve think it was too easy, The Challenge Update might just change your mind.
Here’s the full list of new features and changes that you’ll find in The Challenge Update:
Challenge Mode is a new game mode designed to test your skills with increased difficulty. This mode includes:
New enemies
Harder minigames
Harder bosses
Some layout changes for levels
The ability to fast forward through dialogue and
New Achievements
Pages with combat on have been reworked and side scrolling levels have new layouts.

In the previous version of the game, we had Humgrump teleport some enemies into the level using his metamagic, but only in the book. We've now added these sequences to the desk too. These spawn in with VFX and a bubble that contains Humgrump's face. Additionally, Jot can get electrified on the desk.
Following on from the above, we have the glowing metamagic variants of some of the base enemies. They have their own effects and materials on the desk, and new sprites in the book.
Barfer Bug
Rat
Goblin
Spear Trooper
Popuff
We have some upgraded versions of the existing enemies. These are all across both desk and book.
Tough Goblin (just harder)
Exploding Goblins (run at you and explode)
Metal Goblins (indestructible)
Exploding Jumper bugs
Tough Namastarlings (just harder)
There's a new tough book-only enemy, the Rock Golem, which appears from Chapter 2.

All of the minigames, apart from the Sneak C09 game, Fish Grabbing and the C04 Fantasy Card Game have new difficulty settings and layouts. Buttergrump also has new patterns. There are little bits of extra functionality in some of these games as a result, such as ghost Archery bugs and new projectiles in Buttergrump.

The Plucky Squire with permadeath! This is essentially Challenge Mode but with no continues. As soon as you die in Iron Squire Mode, your save is deleted, and you are sent to a new game over screen. We have one each for desk and the book.
There have been five Challenge Mode-specific achievements added.
Complete Challenge Mode: Pops up at the same point that the Adventure/Story Mode one pops up. It also auto-completes the Adventure/Story Mode too.
Get to Artia in Iron Squire Mode: This triggers at the end of C04 when the camera pans across to show Artia.
Complete all corrupted (Humgrump) Challenge Mode minigames (without skipping)
Boxing
Volleyball
Potion pop
Complete the Big Brawl at the end of C09 without dying.
You can hold the X button or Space Bar to fast forward through all dialogue without repeatedly pressing for each box that pops up.
The dev team has set up a new form so you can directly send in bug and issue reports to them. If you are encountering problems in the game on the latest versions, please send them over here:
The Plucky Squire Public Bug Submission Form
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1627570/The_Plucky_Squire/"]
That's all for now, Squires! We hope you enjoy this new adventure!

items.text: Here's a new patch that addresses a crash in Chapter 7 and that visual issue we mentioned in the last notes.
Fixed a crash when using the bomb stamp in Chapter 7
Fixed the graphical issue causing visible lines on the book pages
Thank you all for the feedback, bug reports and nice messages!
Hey everyone!
We've resolved an issue that was impacting save files from before version 1.15.1.
If your save was getting stuck, you can try it again now. If it doesn't work immediately, please try a few of the autosaves in Save History. You do that by:
> selecting the Save Slot you wish to play
> selecting "Load Game"
> selecting an autosave to try
We've also fixed an issue in Chapter 5 where Jot would lose his sword
There's a graphical bug which is causing a faint line to appear on some pages of the book. That's what we'll be tackling next!
If you encounter more issues and bugs, please let us know in the forums. We're looking at them so we can fix more things as soon as we can.

releases.displayName: See How Our Launch Trailer Was Made + First Update

items.text: After four years of work we finally launched The Plucky Squire this week.
It's quite a thing to spend so long on one project, then release it into the world. Our goal was to give people a wonderful experience, so we are overjoyed to see your reactions!
We appreciate everyone who has followed us and our studio's first game. More than anything, we hope you're enjoying your adventures in the Land of Mojo.
We can't say it enough. Thank you.

By now, we hope you've seen our incredible papercraft launch trailer. But how did paper engineers Julia and Yeray bring our virtual storybook world to real REAL life? Let's go behind the scenes and find out.

We've just released our first patch of fixes to The Plucky Squire. It contains fixes to a number of blockers and other issues. We are continuing to work on more improvements. If you ever get stuck, please try the Save History feature. It will let you access a few recent autosaves It won't solve every problem but additional updates are on the way!

Fixed Jot not respawning correctly when jumping off the edge of the desk near the candle in Chapter 6
Fixed blockers created by stone block being placed on minecart and moved in Chapter 6
Fixed Jot getting stuck in portal on mine cart when stone block is placed on the portal in Chapter 6
Fixed NPCs not following Jot in Chapter 7 (C07_P1516)
Fixed hammer changing into blue gem if taken back to previous page in Chapter 7
Fixed bubbles occasionally not spawning in Chapter 8 minigame
Fixed overexposed textures in desk scenes
Fixed glitchbird count resetting when reloading a save from Save History menu, ‘Saviour of the Glitchbirds’ achievement can now be completed when using Save History functionality
